research_question: Does the MAC projection solver reproduce analytic flows and published laminar benchmarks, and does the panel method support a legitimate aerodynamic optimisation?
hypothesis: H6.1 analytic channel flows reproduced with O(h^2) error. H6.2 cavity centre-line RMS vs Ghia < 0.02 at Re=100 and 400 on 64^2. H6.3 cylinder C_D (DFG 2D-1) within 10% with the staircase boundary. H6.4 marching BL matches Blasius within 1%. H6.5 the optimised airfoil remains feasible at higher panel resolution.
mathematical_formulation: incompressible NS (MAC, Chorin projection); Prandtl BL equations; Hess-Smith panels
dataset_description: Ghia et al. 1982 tables and DFG 2D-1 reference values (fetched; src/aerosynapse/data)
